text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With our busiest days behind us, we
finally have
at least a little downtime on
our hands...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Let's go on that trip to the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I realized something. It's true that I
can't go
with Vodka and Scarlet, since
the ticket is only
for two...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But there's nothing to stop me from
going with
you instead.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So without further ado, we quickly pack
our
things and head off on our
impromptu hot spring
trip.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's so much bigger than in the
pictures.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, passing through there is supposed
to improve
your health. Let's go right on
through.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Testing, testing. Hi! It's Machan. I'm on a
hot
spring trip with my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
These chairs are soft and comfy. The tea
is nice
and hot. It's no wonder this place
is considered a
hidden gem.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This cafe is actually supposed to have a
secret
menu full of local specialties, so I
think I'll try
some. Okay, that's all for
now. End of recording.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
W-we really get to stay here? It's so big
and
sparkly!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Raffles aren't to be taken lightly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Hot springs aren't to be
underestimated
either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan takes us here, there, and

everywhere, and soon enough, the sun
goes
down.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Would you look at that, it's dark
already. The day
just flew by.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We went sightseeing, visited a cafe on
our stroll
around town, and soaked in
the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...We made a lot of memories.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We still have some time before dinner.
Want to
take a little walk?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I heard there's a nice place nearby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Happy to oblige, I join her on a short
walk.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... It's true—there's not another soul
in sight.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And all the stars are shining bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan silently looks up towards
the night
sky.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Would you like to know my secret?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's something that might surprise
you, but
it's true.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I know that I'm a little
strange.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My dream of becoming a mascot, my
fear of
being forgotten...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
When I mention these things to the
other girls,
they don't really seem to
relate, so that's how I
realized.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But that's exactly why... That's why
you're unique.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That day by the sea...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You spoke out against nature and told
me you
wanted me here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You spoke out against nature and told
me you
wanted me here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Life is something you have to go through
alone.
That's what I've always believed,
and I still do.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I was so surprised that
someone would
actually try and
challenge that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It made me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can still feel the warmth of that
happiness now,
deep in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The wind blows through the hills. Aston
Machan
mumbles something.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Can we stay like this?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's a selfish request. I've been saving it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
All our rivers lead to the ocean someday.
The
length and the depth of that river is
different for
everyone, and we each go
at our own pace. But
still. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Will you drift alongside me for as long as
you
can?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm glad you're weird.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Aston Machan and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
